facts.text: You get forty eight hours, Hammond. Eat quickly and stay in my sight.
facts.why: Jack never says this and it is set as his words. The film's bar line is Reggie's 'There's a new sheriff in town. And, his name is Reggie Hammond.'
facts.fix: There's a new sheriff in town. And, his name is Reggie Hammond.

vibe.verdict: Neat case file layout and the redneck bar is in, but the food is generic and Jack's quote is invented.
